learningGoals: Develop logical and critical thinking skills. 🧠
Solve simple visual, spatial, and number puzzles. 🔢
Recognize and complete shapes and visual patterns. 🌀
Build patience, concentration, and problem-solving abilities. 🧘
teachingTips: Encourage your child to try solving a problem on their own before giving them a hint. 🕵️‍♂️
Work on physical jigsaw puzzles together as a fun family activity. 🧩
Point out patterns in everyday life, like the tiles on the floor or stripes on a shirt. 🏁
Ask open-ended questions like 'What do you think comes next?' to stimulate their brain. ❓

funActivities.title: Shape Match ✂️
funActivities.description: Cut paper shapes (circle, square) into halves, mix them up, and ask them to find the matching pieces.

funActivities.title: Number Riddle 🔢
funActivities.description: Play a guessing game: 'I am a number. I am more than 4 but less than 6. Who am I?'

funActivities.title: Pattern Maker 🥄
funActivities.description: Use spoons and forks to create a pattern on the table (spoon, fork, spoon) and ask them to continue it.
